name: dev.interlusion/enterich
title: Enterich
description: A service for ERPNext accounting behind OAuth: fixed tools, drafts only, one agent user's rights

environmentVariables.name: ENTERICH_RESOURCE_URL
environmentVariables.description: The MCP endpoint exactly as clients enter it, https; its path is the one served

environmentVariables.name: ENTERICH_JWKS_URL
environmentVariables.description: The authorization server's signing keys, https

environmentVariables.name: ENTERICH_CLIENT_ID
environmentVariables.description: The OAuth client the agent's tokens are issued to

environmentVariables.name: ENTERICH_REQUIRED_SCOPES
environmentVariables.description: Scopes required in the token, space-separated

environmentVariables.name: ENTERICH_CLOCK_LEEWAY
environmentVariables.description: Seconds of clock leeway for token times, 0 to 60

environmentVariables.name: ENTERICH_ERPNEXT_URL
environmentVariables.description: The base URL Enterich calls ERPNext at

environmentVariables.name: ENTERICH_ERPNEXT_HOST
environmentVariables.description: The Host header sent to ERPNext, by default the URL's host

environmentVariables.name: ENTERICH_ERPNEXT_PUBLIC_URL
environmentVariables.description: The base URL people open ERPNext at, for links in results

environmentVariables.name: ENTERICH_ERPNEXT_API_KEY
environmentVariables.description: The ERPNext agent user's API key

environmentVariables.name: ENTERICH_ERPNEXT_API_SECRET
environmentVariables.description: The ERPNext agent user's API secret

environmentVariables.name: ENTERICH_COMPANY
environmentVariables.description: The assigned company, exactly as named in ERPNext

environmentVariables.name: ENTERICH_TOOLS
environmentVariables.description: The operations to offer, comma-separated; by default all

environmentVariables.name: ENTERICH_TIMEZONE
environmentVariables.description: IANA time zone for today's date, the ERPNext site's

environmentVariables.name: ENTERICH_LOG_LEVEL
environmentVariables.description: The level for libraries' log lines: DEBUG, INFO, WARNING or ERROR
